target.title: Fix queued chat message parity
target.body:
## Summary
- A continuation of #920 which was a draft PR that got merged prematurely
- Mirror web UI queue behavior by assigning each queued tray message a stable send run ID and forwarding it as `chat.send.idempotencyKey`.
- Reconcile queued user messages by queued/run identity instead of prompt text so duplicate prompts remain distinct.
- Treat `in_flight` as deferred admission with bounded backoff, visible failure on exhaustion, and safe handling for active-run and direct-send races.
- Drop ambiguous identity-less assistant retransmits around queued-user boundaries instead of replaying stale output onto the next prompt.

## Validation
- `dotnet test .\tests\OpenClaw.Tray.Tests\OpenClaw.Tray.Tests.csproj --no-restore --filter "FullyQualifiedName~DirectSend_InFlightAckWithoutLifecycle_FailsInsteadOfLeavingTurnActive|FullyQualifiedName~QueuedSend_InFlightAckWhileDifferentRunActive_RequeuesWithoutPromoting|FullyQualifiedName~QueuedSend_InFlightAckWithoutLifecycle_RequeuesAndRetriesSameIdempotencyKey|FullyQualifiedName~QueuedSend_RepeatedInFlightAckWithoutLifecycle_EventuallyFails|FullyQualifiedName~QueuedSend_LifecycleStartBeforeAck_PromotesByIdempotencyKey"` — 5 passed
- Focused retry stress loop — 10/10 iterations passed on affected queue retry tests
- `./build.ps1` — passed
- `dotnet test ./tests/OpenClaw.Shared.Tests/OpenClaw.Shared.Tests.csproj --no-restore` — 2698 passed / 31 skipped
- `dotnet test ./tests/OpenClaw.Tray.Tests/OpenClaw.Tray.Tests.csproj --no-restore` — 1589 passed

## Real behavior proof
- Manual current-head WinUI test submitted three identical `hello` messages through the tray chat UI; all three drained successfully, leaving 0 queued cards and 3 visible `hello` user turns.
- Captured proof artifacts are in the session artifact directory: `queue-proof-before.png`, `queue-proof-queued.png`, `queue-proof-after-30s.png`, `queue-proof-after-90s.png`, and related final queue screenshots.
- Real wire-contract proof added in `GatewayProtocolLiveRoundTripTests.ChatSend_UsesCallerProvidedIdempotencyKeyOnWire`, proving `OpenClawGatewayClient` sends caller-provided `idempotencyKey`.

## Review
- Rubber-duck review: no blocking/actionable correctness findings after final pass.
- Code review: no actionable findings after final pass.

## Not verified / blocked
- Gateway server source was not changed in this PR. Review noted this assumes `in_flight` is the only deferred/non-terminal `chat.send` status emitted by the gateway.
